powerHistory.source: NASA POWER PRECTOTCORR, T2M, T2M_MAX, T2M_MIN, ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN
powerHistory.timeConvention: Original historical export; UTC alignment of every historical rain day is NOT established. Keep distinct from the explicit 2024 UTC matched comparison.

etoHG.method: FAO-56 Hargreaves-Samani, eq. 52, approximate reference ET0 from daily temperature and extraterrestrial radiation
etoHG.warning: Temperature-based screening estimate; local validation needed. NOT a measured evapotranspiration, field water deficit or irrigation advice. Solar variable not used in Hargreaves estimator.

smap.source: SMAP L4 soil moisture, extracted matched point, surface/root zone
smap.warning: Sparse nine sampled dates only. Satellite-model estimate; not plot-scale measured soil moisture. SMAP forcing can contain IMERG.

spatial.source: GPM IMERG Final V07B, 7 June 2024 daily global NetCDF granules + 3 August 2024 granules, 5×5 georeferenced crop
spatial.warning: Only 10 actual dates (June 1–7 and August 1–3, 2024); not a continuous season or historical spatial time series. Satellite pixels are not fields.
